name: Rose
source: Purveyor of the Lake Blue item shop, although she looks more like a dominatrix. Her personality is fairly out of sync relative to the average person. She secretly has Raidy in her sights, hoping to GET her now that she's awakened to her submissive side deep inside the dungeon.
